blocks.text: Build native mobile apps visually and deploy to both app stores

FlutterFlow brings no-code development to native mobile apps by building on Google's Flutter framework. The result is genuinely native applications - not web wrappers - that perform and feel like traditionally coded apps on both iOS and Android.

The visual builder generates clean Flutter/Dart code that you can export and continue developing in any IDE. This is a critical differentiator: you are never locked in. Start no-code, and if your app outgrows the visual builder, your developers can take over the codebase without starting from scratch.

For startups targeting mobile-first markets, FlutterFlow dramatically compresses the timeline from idea to app store. Build your core flows visually, connect to Firebase or Supabase for the backend, and submit to both app stores - all within a single platform.
Real Flutter apps deployed natively to iOS and Android
Export clean Dart/Flutter code for continued development in any IDE
Drag-and-drop interface with component library and responsive layouts
Native Firebase backend for auth, database, and storage
Write custom Dart code for logic the visual builder cannot handle
Direct publishing to Apple App Store and Google Play

FlutterFlow is the only no-code mobile builder we recommend because it generates real native code. You get the speed of no-code without the lock-in - your codebase remains portable if you outgrow the visual builder.
Our team can integrate FlutterFlow into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
